info.name: Sandbox Connect API - Bookings Enabled Notebook APIs
info.description: Postman collection for the API surface active when API_BOOKINGS_ENABLED=true (the server default). Direct notebook create/start/stop/delete routes are intentionally excluded because the router does not register them in this mode. Includes the COS admin platform dashboard for CPU/GPU summary, daily recorded-session trends, user usage and sandbox drill-down.

item.description: Obtains a user access token from Keycloak and saves it into the active mode environment.

item.name: COS Admin Dashboard
item.description: Read-only platform CPU/GPU dashboard, available in both booking and direct modes. Uses the collection bearer token {{access_token}}: supply a signed, unexpired frontend token with realm role cos_admin and azp matching API_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID. aud is not enforced. Ordinary users receive 403; invalid tokens receive 401. Optional blank filters are disabled by default; from and to must be enabled together. Responses can contain partial=true, warnings and null metrics. All saved response examples are synthetic, not live snapshots.

query.description: all, cpu or gpu. Applies to this endpoint only.
Optional inclusive RFC3339 instant. Enable and populate both from and to.
Optional exclusive RFC3339 instant, no later than now. Window must be positive and at most 30 days.

request.description: Overview cards: current CPU/GPU sandbox counts, running resource requests, and recorded booking session hours. History defaults to the last 7 IST calendar days; direct notebooks and browser sessions have no recorded booking history.
